syntheticBasis: The durable Q7 evidence records the repeated field-level failure family and cross-subject occurrence but does not retain provider response bodies as repository fixtures. The executable regression therefore reproduces the observed omission class synthetically without claiming verbatim historical provider output.

topLevelGovernedTargetFields.reason: These values are governed by the selected target policy and can be injected without changing educational meaning.

subquestionMarkAllocation.reason: Distribution of marks across individual tasks carries educational assessment judgement and cannot be safely invented by the compiler. A parseable omission may receive one validator-directed repair before fail-closed validation.

subquestionRequirementAndEvidenceMapping.reason: Mapping governed requirements to the exact learner-facing task and evidence excerpt carries educational meaning. Revision validates it deterministically but does not fabricate the mapping.

postRepairDisposition.reason: After the single permitted repair, any remaining omission or structural/semantic mismatch blocks the worker output.
